A bright, startling light encompassed your vision. As your eyes acclimated, you found yourself standing in an expansive, unfamiliar field that bore an uncanny resemblance to the RPG world you had just been navigating on your screen.

"Welcome to Eldoria," a voice resounded, reverberating in the air around you.

Confused, you scanned your surroundings, trying to comprehend the situation. Without warning, a message emerged in your field of vision.

"Congratulations! You have been chosen to participate in an exclusive immersive gameplay experience. Enjoy your journey."

As the message dissipated, you were left to grapple with the reality of your new circumstance. With no other option, you pressed on, oblivious to the fate that lay before you.

Days evolved into weeks as you adjusted to this new existence, learning to wield powers you had previously only imagined. You formed alliances, battled mythical beasts, and began to find a strange enjoyment in your new life.

But your world shifted the day you crossed paths with him.

Kogo, the Demon King.

His imposing stature and ominous aura were enough to make the bravest warrior shudder. But it was his intense crimson eyes that truly struck fear into your heart, their burning desire seemingly focused solely on you.

As he approached, you found yourself rooted to the spot. A dark, alluring smile twisted his lips, sending a shiver down your spine. He reached out, his large hand gently lifting your chin, forcing you to meet his gaze.

"So, you're the one I've been hearing about," he said, his voice a deep rumble that vibrated in your chest. "I've been waiting for you."

His thumb traced your lower lip, his crimson eyes never leaving yours. "Tell me, what is your name?" he asked, leaning in closer.
